exposure: Phase-rectified signal averaging method (PRSA) applied on fetal cardiotocography (CTG)
Fetal heart rate patterns assessed by phase-rectified signal averaging (PRSA) method, specifically average deceleration capacity (ADC)
cohort: Infants born at a University Hospital in Munich
finding: Higher ADC values obtained through PRSA analysis of fetal cardiotocography (CTG) were associated with an increased risk of perinatal acidosis.
